scope: Offline state-machine recovery from the exact 3.0.2 mobile daemon and shipped frontend.

confirmed_transitions.trigger: connect failure/no service; reconnect policy may retry
disconnect completion followed by reconnect/profile-change path

preconditions_and_disconnect_causes: roaming while roaming policy disallows data
backhaul.timing: Delayed-connect, status-check, and automatic-retry timer paths are present; exact delays vary by callsite and are not exhaustively normalized here.
backhaul.record_commit: The object field at +0x2b8 is copied to temporary record 79 by mobile+0x3a0d8-mobile+0x3a138.
backhaul.confidence: high for states and principal transitions; medium for exhaustive trigger list

registration.notable_collapse: record 81 value 2 represents either searching or secondary-domain registration; consumers cannot distinguish those cases from record 81 alone

confirmed_workflow_edges.to: search failed because SMS was being sent

network_selection.overlay_behavior: Record 76 has permanent automatic/manual policy writers and a temporary writer used by the workflow. Record 84 is the operation status. These are distinct dimensions.
network_selection.event_correlation: The callsites occur in the recovered network scan/config processing paths associated with the 0x20-0x25 and 0x30-0x35 event families, but a complete one-to-one event/status table remains incomplete.
network_selection.confidence: high for enum and observed edges; medium for exhaustive event correlation

producer_map.status: CONFIRMED for 13 of 14 states; state 8 is a negative result
producer_map.canonical_detail: Full per-state writer, trigger and kind are in analysis/modem-control-paths.json under record_84_producers. Summarised here so the state machine is readable on its own.
producer_map.failure_discrimination: States 6 and 7 are produced by one conditional select at mobile 0x370dc, driven by the normalized AT-error enum returned by 0x41110: codes 6 or 13 give state 7, any other non-zero code gives state 6. States 1 and 9 are produced by a second select at 0x3b620 on whether the saved selection is zero.
producer_map.state_8: NEGATIVE EVIDENCE. No setter call site can emit 8. The frontend enumerates the state but this daemon build cannot reach it.

ci_layer.scan: AT+COPS=? -> CI_MM_PRIM_GET_NUM_NETWORK_OPERATORS_REQ (MM 3, primId 20) -> CNF with a count -> an AP-driven loop of CI_MM_PRIM_GET_NETWORK_OPERATOR_INFO_REQ (22) / CNF (23, 80 bytes each). Results are polled, not pushed.
ci_layer.register_automatic: AT+COPS=0 -> GET_BAND_MODE, then SET_BAND_MODE with networkMode = preferredMode = 6 (all RATs), then CI_MM_PRIM_AUTO_REGISTER_REQ (34). Automatic selection therefore resets the preferred-RAT policy at the CI layer.
ci_layer.register_manual: AT+COPS=1|4 -> SET_BAND_MODE with a networkMode derived from the AT AcT value, then CI_MM_PRIM_MANUAL_REGISTER_REQ (36, 42 bytes) carrying either a length-prefixed operator name or numeric MCC/MNC as two u16 fields.
ci_layer.deregister: AT+COPS=2 -> CI_MM_PRIM_DEREGISTER_REQ (38, payload 0). This is the CI primitive behind the internal MP_NetSel mode 2. Static documentation only; never invoked.
ci_layer.cancel: AT+CPLMNS (command type 4) -> CI_MM_PRIM_CANCEL_MANUAL_PLMN_SEARCH_REQ (114, payload 0). Zero payload means it cannot target a specific request; it is a global abort.

derived_call_failure.logic: gate on registration==1 and connection==1; roaming-policy reason has precedence; limiting enabled (30==1), hard limit reached (39==2), and no current-boot dial override (44==0) yields reason 2; default 0

preferred_rat_policy.modem_transport: AT*BAND NwMode/PreferMode operation over the AP AT boundary at /tmp/atcmd
preferred_rat_policy.staging: The event handler stages the requested value at status-object +0x194 before invoking the modem-manager operation; the AT builder reads either that staged value or the value passed through the virtual call.
preferred_rat_policy.persistence_rule: Record 75 is persisted only after the modem-manager operation returns 0, and again from the AT layer once the transaction completes successfully. A request that the modem rejects does not become durable policy.
preferred_rat_policy.cp_runtime: CP AT*BAND handler -> CI/MM/SAC RAT and service-manager state -> L1CSetRat and registration/service indications
preferred_rat_policy.persistence: AP mobile_config.net_config.pref_net is confirmed persistent; a specific CP .nvm owner is not established
preferred_rat_policy.confidence: high for the AP event/payload/gating/persistence chain and for both numeric conversion tables; supported inference for which AT*BAND builder is live; unknown for the authoritative CP NwMode enumeration, the internal CP call edge, and CP persistence
